profile.headline: Tech Lead at John Deere
profile.summary: Among my goals in life, I want to continue my studies and go beyond. Get a good job that allows me to apply my knowledge is one of my priorities and have a salary enough to be independent, yet able to return to my parents and sister all the help they have given me. Use my work and expertise to help create a better society.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working as Lead for a Software Development team I follow scrum ceremonies, architect, design and code solutions that fit Deere's specifications.

I mainly work with Java Spring Boot and ASP.Net C# microservices. For frontend my technologies of choice are Angular 8+ and Blazor or or Razor pages (depending if needing SPA or Templating is enough).

For CI/CD use Azure DevOps or Gitlab. The hosting environment is most of the time a cloud provider like Azure or AWS,  deploying either on Azure App Services, AWS ECS or AWS EKS.

Other tools in the infrastructure that I use are: ActiveMQ, Aurora DB, SQL Server, S3, SOLR.

Other technologies I'm using right now:
Intel Hex, A2L, CAN

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Java Software Engineer.
Working on a scrum team I use my skills for leading the efforts towards the spring goal, I also code enhancements, bug fixes and scripts for JDCP micro services.
I'm also experienced building RESTful services with Java Spring Boot & AspNet 5, also covering the frontend with Angular8+ apps and coding the deployment of the same ones to ECS & EKS (Kubernetes) into the private AWS cloud infrastructure  y using modern CI/CD tools like Azure DevOps or Gitlab pipelines.
As database we use a variety of tools, ranging from IBM DB2, Postgress, Aurora and MySQL. For the data to be more searchable we use SOLR and search engine.

I have also enough experience working with ASP.Net Core web applications, Blazor and SQL Server.
